issues.description: NaN scores are not rejected or clamped, causing SQLite IntegrityError when ingested.
Malformed XML raises ParseError and aborts the entire ingest instead of producing a structured warning.
Format B assumes metrics is a dict; a non-empty list or other truthy value crashes with AttributeError.
Re-ingesting a changed dataset leaves stale results and model_aliases while replacing warnings/stats, making reports inconsistent.
Empty input directories are detected only after ingest creates or mutates the SQLite database.
Duplicate run_id/source rows silently overwrite for all sources even though correction semantics are only documented for Format B.
File decoding and parser setup errors are uncaught, so bad UTF-8 or unreadable inputs crash instead of warning and skipping.
A --db path whose parent directory does not exist raises an uncaught sqlite3.OperationalError.
Format A parses CSV one physical line at a time, so valid quoted multiline CSV fields cannot be handled correctly.
Project metadata does not declare dev/test extras such as pytest, making clean contributor setup less reproducible.
